prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1292; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing running along the left quarter panel. The pattern of the damage lines up well with the impact that was described, and nothing in the inspection points to earlier body work or prior harm to the vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the quarter panel, and a modest amount of labor for alignment of the trunk lid. The labor hours requested are consistent with the work involved, and the invoices submitted show no duplicated or repeated charges. Parts were listed at standard rates. Recommend approval of the estimate as submitted.
